appraisal_events.evidence: j'ai justement eu, de moi-même, cette idée que vous aimeriez mieux rester ici ce soir. Et c'est précisément cela que j'étais allé demander au capitaine. — Sans aucune difficulté.
appraisal_events.explanation: Saint-Loup is shown having anticipated the narrator's unspoken wish on his own initiative and having gone to secure the captain's permission, which he obtains without any difficulty; this casts him as thoughtful and effective.

status_effects.explanation: His effortless success in obtaining the captain's permission ('Sans aucune difficulté') locally shows his standing and effectiveness with authority.
Because of Saint-Loup's initiative, the narrator is spared the solitary suffering he feared and is instead included for the night, a locally favorable turn for him.
